'''Alamites''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[humanoid]] [[species]] native to the [[planet]] [[Mandalore]], where they once resided in the deserted wastelands beyond the [[City|cities]]. After the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Great Purge of Mandalore|purge]] of Mandalore, some Alamites relocated to the ruins of [[Sundari]]. At some point, numerous Alamites attacked [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] and [[Din Djarin]] in the outskirts of Sundari.<ref name="Chapter 18" />

==Biology and appearance==
Alamites were an average sized [[humanoid]] [[species]] that were native to [[Mandalore]]. Before the [[Great Purge of Mandalore|Great Purge]], they lived in the Mandalorian wastelands in between the dome cities, but after the Purge, they migrated to the ruins of [[Sundari]]. They had two notable physical distinctions separating them from most humanoids, and those were having tusks and four [[eye]]s. According to [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], they were known to eat [[human]]s.<ref name="Chapter 18" />
